nunix-secrets.description: Per-host secrets for the nunix flake (secrets.yaml under anubis, common, osiris, server). Used by the NixOS configuration, likely via sops-nix or similar. Reference for resolving secret names and structure during service migrations.

omarchy.description: Old shell that I used for my desktop experience. I liked some of the choices and they are worth bringing over, but only when you are specifically asked to.

dotfiles.description: My old dotfiles used in conjuction with Omarchy, only look into it when asked to bring something over.
